user.title: Connect to Drift Beacon
user.description:
Enter your Drift Beacon hub's address and an API key. To get a key, create one under **API Keys** in your workspace's settings in the Drift Beacon dashboard, and paste it here. The key decides which workspace and user Home Assistant acts for.

{detected}

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of your Drift Beacon hub.
data_description.port: The hub's HTTP port (9821 unless you changed it).
data_description.verify_ssl: Only used over HTTPS. Turn off for a hub with a self-signed certificate, which the Home Assistant app has unless you gave it your own.
data_description.api_token: An API key from your workspace's settings in the Drift Beacon dashboard.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Drift Beacon
reauth_confirm.description: The API key for {workspace} no longer works. Paste a new key for the same workspace and user ({user}): create one under **API Keys** in your workspace's settings in the Drift Beacon dashboard.

reconfigure.title: Change the Drift Beacon hub's address
reconfigure.description: Update where Home Assistant reaches your Drift Beacon hub. The API key is kept, and is only sent if the address answers as this entry's hub.

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of your Drift Beacon hub.
data_description.port: The hub's HTTP port (9821 unless you changed it).
data_description.verify_ssl: Only used over HTTPS. Turn off for a hub with a self-signed certificate, which the Home Assistant app has unless you gave it your own.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Set up Drift Beacon
zeroconf_confirm.description: Home Assistant found the Drift Beacon hub {name} at {host}. Set it up? Next you paste an API key: create one under **API Keys** in your workspace's settings in the Drift Beacon dashboard.

error.invalid_auth: The API key was rejected, or it no longer grants access to its workspace.
error.invalid_server: No Drift Beacon hub answered at that address and port.
error.ssl_verification_failed: The hub's TLS certificate could not be verified. If it has a self-signed certificate (the Home Assistant app does unless you gave it your own), turn off certificate verification.
error.workspace_not_found: The API key's workspace no longer exists on this hub.
error.wrong_workspace: This API key belongs to a different workspace. Add that workspace as a new entry instead.
error.wrong_user: This API key belongs to a different user. Use a key for the same user, or add the workspace again.
error.wrong_hub: That address answers as a different Drift Beacon hub from this entry's, so the API key wasn't sent. Give the address of this entry's hub, or add the other hub as a new entry.

abort.already_configured: This workspace is already set up.
abort.wrong_workspace: The hub at that address has a different workspace for this API key.
abort.already_in_progress: Configuration flow is already in progress
abort.invalid_discovery: The hub's announcement on the network was incomplete.
abort.no_ipv4_address: The hub was found without an IPv4 address, which this integration needs.

auth_failed.message: The Drift Beacon API key was rejected, or now belongs to a different workspace or user.

workspace_not_found.message: The Drift Beacon workspace for this entry no longer exists.

wrong_hub.message: {address} now answers as another Drift Beacon hub ({found}), not the one this entry was set up with ({expected}), so the API key wasn't sent. Home Assistant keeps trying, and follows the hub when it finds it at a new address. You can also give its address with Reconfigure.

not_connected.message: Drift Beacon is not connected right now.

devices_only.message: Drift Beacon actions only accept devices as targets. Choose an activity or workspace device.

no_target.message: Choose at least one Drift Beacon device.

not_drift_beacon_device.message: Device {device_id} is not a Drift Beacon device.

workspace_not_loaded.message: The Drift Beacon workspace {workspace} is not loaded.

not_activity_device.message: {device} is not a Drift Beacon activity.

not_workspace_device.message: {device} is an activity. Choose its workspace device for this action.

activity_unavailable.message: {device} is no longer an active Drift Beacon activity.

plugin_command_may_have_run.message: {plugin} {command} may have run, but Drift Beacon couldn't confirm it: {message}

plugin_command_one_workspace.message: Choose one workspace to get a response from {service}.

legacy_entry.title: Re-add the Drift Beacon workspace {title}
legacy_entry.description: This version of Drift Beacon models each activity as its own device and cannot migrate entries created by earlier versions. Remove the {title} entry and add the workspace again.

workspace_not_found.title: Drift Beacon workspace {title} not found
workspace_not_found.description: The server no longer has the workspace for {title}. If it was deleted, remove this entry. Home Assistant keeps retrying in case it comes back.

track_activity.name: Track activity
track_activity.description: Timed activities start, or stop if you are already tracking them. Point activities record one occurrence.

pause_activity.name: Pause activity
pause_activity.description: End this timed activity's live session and pin it for later. Does nothing if it is not live.

pin_activity.name: Pin activity
pin_activity.description: Make this your pinned activity. The previous pin moves to the front of your queue.

unpin_activity.name: Unpin activity
unpin_activity.description: Unpin this activity if it is pinned. With auto-advance on, the next queued activity is pinned.

queue_activity.name: Queue activity
queue_activity.description: Add this activity to the back of your queue. With auto-advance on and nothing pinned, it is pinned instead. Each call adds another entry.

stop_session.name: Stop session
stop_session.description: Stop your live session in this workspace, whichever activity it belongs to. Ending a shared session ends it for everyone in it.

pause_session.name: Pause session
pause_session.description: End your live session in this workspace and pin its activity to resume later.
